require_upper.description: Require at least one uppercase letter

require_lower.description: Require at least one lowercase letter

require_symbol.description: Require at least one special character

history_count.description: Number of previous passwords to reject (0 = disabled)

max_age_days.description: Force password change after N days (0 = never)

min_age_hours.description: Minimum time before a password can be changed again

custom_pattern.description: Optional regexp for additional password validation

custom_message.description: Error message shown when custom_pattern fails
